memory_title: Identifier occurrence is not identifier origin

observed: The canonical continuity queue requires immutable provenance for M-004, M-005, and M-006 and forbids reconstruction of unverified history.
Repository code search returned no indexed file result for the exact token M-004.

Repository commit search returned only later continuity reconciliation commits containing M-004, including commits that explicitly classify the origin as unresolved or record namespace rejection and temporal boundaries.
File Library search returned V8/V9 proof-machine identifiers such as V8-004 and V9-004; these are suffix collisions in a different namespace and semantic role.
inferred: The first discoverable repository commit mentioning M-004 in a bounded search is a downstream reconciliation record, not evidence of the original assignment.
A lexical suffix match across namespaces cannot establish continuity-artifact identity.
proposed: Promote a candidate origin only when an immutable object explicitly assigns the exact M-00x identifier and satisfies namespace, owner, semantic-role, and temporal-precedence agreement.
Record search-method coverage separately from claim resolution so bounded silence cannot be mistaken for exhaustive absence.
superseded: Treating V8-004, V9-004, or analogous numbered records as candidates for M-004 solely because the numeric suffix matches.
Treating a later provenance-gap record as the historical origin of the identifier it discusses.
unresolved: The originating decision log, language lexicon, project document, chat-history locator, branch, or commit that first assigned M-004, M-005, and M-006 remains unlocated.
An exhaustive branch inventory and reachable-history traversal was not available through the current connector search surface.

contradictions_resolved.apparent_contradiction: A record can be the earliest search result and still not be the origin.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: Search-result precedence is coverage-relative; origin requires explicit assignment plus semantic and namespace agreement.

contradictions_resolved.apparent_contradiction: File Library contains matching numbered identifiers but continuity provenance remains unresolved.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: The matching suffixes belong to V8/V9 proof-machine namespaces and different semantic roles, so they are rejected collisions rather than continuity origins.
